title: fix(app-shell): a served form item becomes the create/edit form only when it is the default; no first-named promotion (objectui#11539)
body:
Fixes #11539

Clause-②: no

## What changes

`applyViewItem` in `packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx` now sets an object's create/edit `.form` only from a served form item that carries `isDefault`. The `|| !bucket.form` leg, which made the first form item to arrive the `.form` whenever no item was default, is gone. The function's docblock states the rule. `bucket.primary` (the list family) is untouched.

## Why

`@objectstack/spec` `ViewSchema`: `form` is a container's "Default form view", `formViews` are "Additional named form views". objectstack-ai/objectstack#21535 (on objectstack `main` as `41b13331`) serves exactly that: the container's own `form` arrives as `OBJECT.form` with `isDefault`, and a container with no `form` serves its named forms with no `isDefault` key. With the old merge rule the console still promoted the first named form, so `showcase_inquiry` (whose only form is the public, anonymous contact-us form) rendered that form as its create and edit form.

## The no-default-form path (named and pinned, not changed)

When `.form` is unset, the read shared by `resolveFormViewLayout`, `RecordFormPage` and `ScreenView` (`.form`, then `formViews.default`) finds nothing. No served row lands under `formViews.default`: merged keys are canonical `OBJECT.KEY` names. So:
- New/Edit dialog (`AppContent`) and action-opened forms (`useActionModal`): `resolveFormViewLayout` returns `{}`. `ModalForm` gets no sections and lays out the object's own fields (its `fieldGroups` fallback, else the flat field list). This is the answer for an object that declares no form view at all, pinned by the existing test `falls back to the full schema when the object declares no form view`.
- Page mode (`RecordFormPage`): `formDef` resolves to `{}`, so the layout is `simple` with no sections.

`ModalForm.tsx` is not touched. Batch sibling objectui#11542 changes how it renders a view's sections, and the new render pin here uses only the no-sections path.

## Pins

`MetadataProvider.merge.test.ts`, new describe `.form is the served default form only (objectui#11539)`, with fixtures shaped as served rows (`name, object, viewKind, label, config, order, scope, isDefault?`) in the order the expansion emits them:
- `showcase_inquiry` shape (named forms only): no `.form`; the named form stays in `formViews` under its name; the create/edit layout equals the layout for an object with no form view.
- `crm_lead`: the default arrives AFTER the named Web-to-Lead form and still takes `.form`.
- `showcase_contact`: keeps `.form` in both arrival orders.
- A named form arriving after the default does not displace it.
- Container gate: a container's declared `form` becomes `.form`, not the named form beside it.

`createModalHonorsFormView.test.tsx`: the real `ModalForm`, fed the layout resolved from a merged named-only object, renders every object field and not the named form's section.

## Measured (PM hypotheses)

1. Confirmed: the promotion was the `|| !bucket.form` leg in `applyViewItem` at base `6f5719e1c`.
2. Falsified: no downstream site picks a first `formViews` entry. `RecordFormPage`, `ScreenView` and `resolveFormViewLayout` (used by `AppContent` and `useActionModal`) read `.form`, then the key `formViews.default` by name. A grep of `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src` for `formViews` readers and first-entry reads found no other site.
3. Pinned both orders (above).
4. Named and pinned (above).
5. `bucket.primary` is set only from `isDefault`; it has no first-wins leg.

## Ablation (one-shot, mutations via objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to HEAD blob `6a7b9077` with an empty `git diff HEAD` each time)

- Old rule restored (`view.isDefault || !bucket.form`): 3 failed, 18 passed of 21. The red tests are the two `showcase_inquiry` pins and the modal render pin.
- Last wins (`bucket.form = entry` unconditionally): 4 failed of 18 (merge file). The red tests are the two `showcase_inquiry` pins, `showcase_contact` both orders, and the named-after-default pin.
- First wins (`if (!bucket.form)`): 5 failed of 18 (merge file). The red tests are the container `form` pin, the two `showcase_inquiry` pins, `crm_lead` default-after, and `showcase_contact`.

## Local verification at `8828bfa`

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`: 28 of 28 tasks successful, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` confirms that both edited test files are in the test tsconfig.
- Tests, narrowed and declared: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over 162 files, 1633 tests passed, exit 0. The set is the app-shell and console tests that name the provider module, `mergeViewsIntoObjects`, `resolveFormViewLayout`, `recordFormNavigation` or `attachInlineSubforms`, plus every app-shell and console test that writes a form-family view (`viewKind: 'form'` or `formViews`). The changed line runs only for a form-family view, so a test that supplies none cannot observe it. Blind spot: a test that feeds form views from a fixture file that is not named in its source. No app-shell test imports from `examples/`. A full `packages/app-shell/` run (974 files) was started and stopped unfinished after 18 minutes on the shared box. The full suite is declared to CI's `pnpm test` shards.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-test-path-roots.mjs`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape.mjs`: all exit 0.
- ESLint on the three touched source files (the package's own `eslint .` config): 0 errors. `MetadataProvider.tsx` has 52 warnings before and after.

## Acceptance notes

- **Stack gate, unchanged by design.** A container that reaches the console unexpanded is expanded by the bundled `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 `expandViewContainer`. Measured: for a named-only container it still stamps `isDefault: true` on the first named form (`showcase_inquiry.contact`). That path keeps the promotion until objectui's normal spec bump carries objectstack-ai/objectstack#21535, which the card scopes out.
- **List family in the bundled spec.** The same 17.5.0 expansion promotes the first named list when a container has no `list`. That is spec-side and outside this ruling. The console's own `bucket.primary` has no such leg.
- **`formViews.default` read.** `RecordFormPage`, `ScreenView` and `resolveFormViewLayout` fall back to a `formViews` key literally named `default` on the object definition. It is a lookup by name, not first-wins, and no served row lands under that key. Observation only; it is not filed.
- **`addRecord.formView` has no reader in the console.** The spec's `AddRecordConfigSchema.formView` is "Named form view to use when mode is form or modal", but `ListView` reads only `addRecord.enabled` and `.position`, and calls `onAddRecord` with no arguments. A word-grep for `formView` over `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src` finds only the `@object-ui/types` declaration. `showcase_contact` writes `addRecord: { mode: 'form', formView: 'create' }`. This was found by reading the source only, with no runtime reading, and is reported to the seat rather than filed. Named forms otherwise stay reachable by name through the console's `/forms/NAME` route.
